title: ci: add artifact signing, SBOM, and provenance manifests for private-installer releases
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adds artifact signing (cosign), SBOM generation (syft), and provenance manifest production to the private-installer release pipeline. Verifiers added to bootstrap to validate signed artifacts on install. No breaking changes to public APIs.
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require cryptographic provenance and verifiable SBOMs for security/compliance. This PR integrates artifact signing, SBOM generation, and provenance manifest emission into the private-installer release pipeline and makes the installer verify signed artifacts during bootstrap.

What this does (high level):
- Adds a release workflow step that builds installer artifacts (helm charts, tarballs, terraform modules), generates SBOMs using Syft, produces signed provenance.json using in-toto style metadata, and signs artifacts with cosign using the CI ephemeral key managed by the release process.
- Produces three release artifacts alongside the package: <name>.tar.gz, <name>.sbom.json, <name>.provenance.json and corresponding .sig files.
- Adds a CI verification job that runs cosign verify and checks the provenance/SBOM against a small set of policy assertions (expected files, checksums, builder id).
- Updates helm packaging job to include provenance labels and reproducible tarball ordering (sort deterministic file list).
- Adds runtime verifier script (installer/bin/verify_release.sh) which is invoked early in the private-installer bootstrap process when install verification is enabled. The verifier fetches the public key from the configured keyserver (or uses pinned public key in air-gapped mode) and validates signatures and SBOM contents.

Why this change: Customers running private deployments require attestable artifacts for security audits and supply-chain assurance. This also helps automated upgrade/rollback tooling make safer decisions by validating artifact integrity.

Backward compatibility and opt-in behavior: Verification in the installer is opt-in (VERIFY_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS env var). Existing installations are unaffected unless they enable verification. Release artifacts are backward-compatible; installers that do not perform verification will ignore the extra files.

Implementation notes:
- Uses GitHub Actions release workflow (/.github/workflows/release-private-installer.yml) to orchestrate build->sbom->provenance->signing->upload.
- Uses syft v0.70.0 (pinned) for SBOM generation and cosign v2.2.1 for signing/verification. Versions are pinned to avoid CI flakiness; upgrade notes are added to docs.
- Provenance format is a lightweight in-toto-compatible JSON with builder id, build env hashes, input checksums, and artifact checksums. The workflow writes provenance.json and signs it.
- Adds a small Makefile target in terraform/modules/installer for packaging terraform modules reproducibly.

Notes & limitations:
- CI stores private signing keys in the release pipeline's ephemeral key store (rotated per-run). For enterprise/private-installer customers who require BYOK, the release pipeline exposes steps to inject an HSM-backed signer (documented).
- Full SBOM policy enforcement is out of scope for this PR; we emit SBOMs and include a lightweight policy checklist in CI. Follow-ups will add stricter gating and CVE checks.

Testing performed:
- End-to-end release dry-run in staging: artifacts produced, SBOMs validated, cosign verify passed.
- Installer verification tested with pinned public key in an air-gapped environment.
- Unit tests for new scripts and CI glue.

Follow-ups:
- Add CVE scanning to CI using Grype against produced SBOMs (ENG-1302).
- Add optional transparency log push for cosign signatures (tied to enterprise opt-in).

review_comments: Liam Chen (review): Please pin syft/cosign versions and add a comment about reproducible ordering in tarball creation. Also double-check that provenance.json contains builder id/commit hash.
Sofia Patel (author): Done. Pinned syft v0.70.0 and cosign v2.2.1. Added deterministic file ordering and included GIT_COMMIT in provenance builder metadata.
Priya Rao (review): For air-gapped customers we need a documented process for providing the public key. Can you add a note?
Sofia Patel (author): Added README_RELEASE.md section with BYOK/HSM integration and steps for pinning a public key into the installer images (air-gap flow).
Marco Giannini (review): Can we run cosign verify in a separate ephemeral runner to limit key exposure?

Sofia Patel (author): The workflow separates signing (on ephemeral runner with restricted secrets) and verification (on a distinct verification job that only uses public keys). Added explicit runner labels and rationale in workflow comments.

ci: add artifact signing, sbom, and provenance manifests for private-installer releases

Signed-off-by: Sofia Patel <sofia@redwood.ai>
notes_for_ops: When rotating keys, ensure CI release workflows are updated with new cosign public key and old releases remain verifiable by retaining previous public keys in the verifier config. See README_RELEASE.md for keys/air-gap instructions.
hermetic_builds_note: Added deterministic tarball ordering and Makefile targets to reduce non-determinism for SBOM checks. Not fully hermetic yet; follow-up planned.
security_implications: Introduces supply-chain signing and SBOMs which improves security posture. Care taken to isolate signing secrets to ephemeral runners; documented BYOK for enterprise customers.
